subject: Distribution / Connector Safeguards for OpenFoundry weights
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@openfoundry.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership inquiry — distribution + connector safeguards

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking a look at OpenFoundry — we publish a family of legal/comms models that customers want to run in low-latency pods. We'd like to explore distributing our weights through Redwood's partner channel (ISV connector + packaged runtime images). A few things we need to validate up front:

- Controlled access: we need per-customer accounting and the ability to revoke access for specific accounts.
- No rehosting: buyers shouldn't be able to rehost raw weights (we're fine if Redwood provides optimized runtime images).
- Attribution + provenance: we require a short attribution string shown in the console and a signed manifest (SHA256).
- Embargoes / mirrored copies: ask about mirror policy for disaster recovery.
- Security: SOC2 evidence and a standard security questionnaire.

I attached a short term sheet and an extract of our model signing metadata. Can we schedule a 30-minute call next week to run through technical constraints and a mutual action plan? Evan at Mosaic Labs is cc'd — they're helping with packaging recommendations.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, OpenFoundry
Attachments: openfoundry-distribution-term-sheet.pdf (pdf), model-signing-extract.txt (text)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@openfoundry.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 09:14:23 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — distribution + connector safeguards

Hi Marta — great to hear from you and thanks for the docs. Happy to run this through our partner onboarding flow. Quick response and proposed next steps: 

1) Intro call (30m) — I'll set something up for next week; please include your technical lead.
2) NDA / CLA — we'll need a publisher CLA (we can accept yours or have you review ours).
3) Mutual action plan (MAP) — Priyom will own ops checklist and packaging requirements.
4) Legal / security evidence — Sergio, can you confirm the baseline (SOC2 + pen test summary) that we require?

A few clarifying asks from the product side:
- What formats do you prefer for distribution: safetensors only, or are you ok with an additional runtime image prepared by you?
- Any runtime flags or quantization profiles you don't want redistributed?
- Expected size and peak QPS so we can recommend Dedicated vs Hosted routing.

Priyom / Sergio — can you join the call and review the attached term sheet? Marta — I'll propose times shortly.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@openfoundry.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — distribution + connector safeguards

Marta / Soojin — following up with an initial mutual action plan and ops checklist (attached). High level items we expect to complete before we publish in the Redwood ISV catalog: 

- Security/compliance: completed questionnaire + SOC2 report + summary of pen test remediation.
- Legal: signed CLA (we can use a 3rd-party DocuSign flow); redlines we typically expect are around attribution and resale rights.
- Packaging: safetensors + manifest.json (SHA256) OR an OpenFoundry-provided runtime image (OCI tar). We require model files be signed and checksums verified on ingest.
- Escrow / embargo: If you require an embargo period, we can hold distribution and only make images available to approved accounts. Mirrors: Redwood allows mirrors for DR but mirror copies must be encrypted and access-controlled.
- Distribution constraints: no raw weights redistribution; Redwood can provide converted runtime images (we'll publish the recommended config).
- Billing / revenue share: suggest a 70/30 split (publisher / Redwood) for Hosted API calls; for Dedicated we charge an integration fee + per-image listing fee.
- Attribution: short string in the console + a link to your license.

Attached: MAP_OpenFoundry-v1.xlsx, redwood-publisher-checklist.md
DocuSign envelope (template): https://docusign.example/envelope/abc123

Open items for legal review (Sergio): please confirm whether the clause 'no reverse-engineering of model outputs to reconstruct weights' is enforceable in the CLA and whether we need an explicit export control addendum.

Marta — would appreciate any non-negotiable terms from OpenFoundry (licensing, embargo length, attribution language).

— Priyom
Partner Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_OpenFoundry-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-publisher-checklist.md (markdown)
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@openfoundry.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partnership inquiry — distribution + connector safeguards

Thanks — this looks good and aligned. A couple quick updates: 

- We've signed the CLA and completed the DocuSign envelope. See attached OF-CLA-signed.pdf and the envelope ID above.
- Non-negotiables: 1) no public rehosting of raw weights, 2) attribution string exactly: "OpenFoundry - legal-v1 (© OpenFoundry)", 3) embargo window up to 60 days for select partners.
- Packaging: we'll deliver safetensors + signed manifest. We can also provide a prebuilt OCI runtime image if Redwood prefers.
- Go-live: target July 15, 2027 for limited release to early partners. We'll need an onboarding session and a sandbox token for testing (please issue an early-access token scoped to 10k tokens/day).

Next steps from our side: I'll send the signed CLA PDF to your legal inbox and schedule the technical workshop. If you can confirm the onboarding date (week of July 12) and send the sandbox token, we'll proceed with packaging.

Best regards,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, OpenFoundry
Attachments: OF-CLA-signed.pdf (pdf)
